name: runner-tmux-own-socket
description: ADR 0350: runner-local runs every job in tmux on the factory's own socket (`tmux -L software-factory -f /dev/null`), so the owner's own tmux server, sessions and config are never touched. Every tmux call goes through runner-local's tmux wrapper, which always passes the socket.
message: Call tmux only through tmuxCli (packages/runner-local/src/tmux.ts), which targets the factory's own socket without the owner's config. Never run tmux on the default socket. See ADR 0350.
